settings.name_in_paper: Winner-regret with Top-m-ranking Feedback (MNL model, subsets of size at most k)
unmapped: Feedback is a top-m rank-ordered list drawn from the Plackett-Luce / MNL model on the played subset (m=1 is winner feedback)
Actions are subsets of [n] of size between 1 and k
Regret r_t = sum_{i in S_t}(theta_{a*} - theta_i)/|S_t| (average MNL parameter shortfall)
Learner knows subset size bound k and feedback length m
settings.definition_quote: At any round t, the learner can play sets of size 1,...,k, but is penalised for playing any item other than a^*. Formally, we define the learner's instantaneous regret at round t as r_t^1 = \sum_{i \in S_t}\frac{(\theta_{a^*} - \theta_i)}{|S_t|}

settings.name_in_paper: Winner-regret with Top-m-ranking / Winner Feedback (lower bound)
unmapped: Plackett-Luce / MNL top-m ranking feedback on played subset
Actions are subsets of [n] of size up to k
settings.definition_quote: For any No-regret learning algorithm A for Winner-regret that uses Winner Feedback, and for any problem instance MNL(n,theta)...

unmapped: Subsets of size exactly k played; full Plackett-Luce ranking of the k items observed
Regret r_t = (theta_{S_(k)} - sum_{i in S_t} theta_i)/k
settings.definition_quote: we assume that the learner can play sets of k distinct items at each round t. The instantaneous regret ... r_t^k = (\theta_{S_{(k)}} - \sum_{i \in S_t}\theta_i)/k

unmapped: Subsets of size exactly k; full Plackett-Luce ranking feedback
settings.definition_quote: For any No-regret learning algorithm A for Top-k-regret that uses Top-k-ranking Feedback...

symbols.theta_star: MNL parameter of the best item a*

conditions: algorithm is No-regret: E[N_S(T)] = o(T^alpha) for every suboptimal set S

source.label: thm:lb_wiwf
source.quote: For any No-regret learning algorithm A for Winner-regret that uses Winner Feedback, and for any problem instance MNL(n,theta) s.t. a^* = argmax theta_i, the expected regret incurred by A satisfies liminf_{T\to\infty} E[R_T^1(A)/ln T] \ge \frac{\theta_{a^*}}{(\min_{i}\frac{\theta_{a^*}}{\theta_i} - 1)}(n-1).

results.notes: K = n items. Statement says 'for any instance' but proof only constructs a specific instance (theta_2=...=theta_n) and gets a (1-alpha) factor.

symbols.theta_star: MNL parameter of the best item a*
symbols.m_fb: length m of top-m ranking feedback

conditions: there exists a problem instance (worst-case instance construction)

source.label: thm:lb_witf
source.quote: For any No-regret algorithm A for the Winner-regret problem with Top-m-ranking Feedback, there exists a problem instance MNL(n,theta) such that the expected Winner-regret incurred by A satisfies liminf E[R_T^1(A)/ln T] \ge \frac{\theta_{a^*}}{(\min_{i}\frac{\theta_{a^*}}{\theta_i} - 1)}\frac{(n-1)}{m}

symbols.theta_star: MNL parameter of the best item a*

source.label: thm:lb_wiwf2
source.quote: For any No-regret algorithm A for Winner-regret with Winner Feedback, there exists a problem instance of MNL(n,theta) model, such that the expected regret incurred by A on it satisfies liminf E[R_T^1(A)/ln T] \ge \frac{\theta_{a^*}}{4(\min_{i} p_{a^*,i} - 0.5)}(n-1)

symbols.D_sum: D = sum_{i<j} D_ij, with D_ij = 4 alpha / min(Delta_i^2, Delta_j^2) and D_1i = 4 alpha/Delta_i^2, Delta_i = (theta_{a*}-theta_i)/(2(theta_{a*}+theta_i))
symbols.m_fb: length m of top-m ranking feedback

tuning: algorithm does not require delta as input

source.label: thm:whp_reg_mm
source.quote: Fix a time horizon T and \delta \in (0,1), \alpha > 1/2. With probability at least (1-\delta), the regret of MaxMin-UCB for Winner-regret with Top-m-ranking Feedback satisfies R_T^1 \le (2[\frac{2\alpha n^2}{(2\alpha-1)\delta}]^{\frac{1}{2\alpha-1}} + 2D\ln 2D)\hat\Delta_{\max} + \frac{\ln T}{m+1}\sum_{i=2}^n(D_{\max}\hat\Delta_i)

results.notes: Algorithm uses ln t, no horizon needed, hence anytime. Lemma in appendix gives refinement with D_1i when m=1.

symbols.m_fb: length m of top-m ranking feedback

tuning: alpha > 1 implicitly required for the integral to be finite (paper states alpha > 1/2)

source.label: thm:exp_reg_mm
source.quote: The expected regret of MaxMin-UCB for Winner-regret with Top-m-ranking Feedback is: E[R_T^1] \le ( 2[\frac{2\alpha n^2}{(2\alpha-1)}]^{\frac{1}{2\alpha-1}}\frac{2\alpha-1}{\alpha-1} + 2D\ln 2D)\hat\Delta_{\max} + \frac{\ln T}{m+1}\sum_{i=2}^n(D_{\max}\hat\Delta_i), in T rounds.

results.notes: Obtained by integrating the high-probability bound over delta; the integral of delta^{-1/(2alpha-1)} converges only for alpha > 1, not stated explicitly.

source.label: thm:lb_tktf
source.quote: For any No-regret learning algorithm A for Top-k-regret that uses Top-k-ranking Feedback, and for any problem instance MNL(n,theta), the expected regret incurred by A when run on it satisfies liminf E[R_T^k(A)/ln T] \ge \frac{\theta_1\theta_{k+1}}{\Delta_{(k)}}\frac{(n-k)}{k}

results.notes: Stated for any instance but proof constructs a specific instance.

bound.expression_latex: \bigg( 2\Big[\frac{2\alpha n^2}{(2\alpha-1)\delta} \Big]^{\frac{1}{2\alpha-1}} + 2\bar D^{(k)}\ln \big( 2\bar D^{(k)}\big) \bigg) \Delta'_{\max} + \frac{4\alpha\ln T}{k}\bigg(\sum_{b = k+1}^{n}\frac{(\theta_k-\theta_b)}{{\hat D}^2} \bigg)

symbols.D_bar: instance-dependent constant bar D^(k) = sum_r D^(r) (Lemma t_hat_deltak)
symbols.Sum_b: sum_{b=k+1}^n (theta_k - theta_b)/hat D^2, hat D = min_{g in [k-1]} (p_kg - p_bg)

source.label: thm:whp_reg_kmm
source.quote: Given a fixed time horizon T and \delta \in (0,1), with high probability (1-\delta), the regret incurred by Rec-MaxMin-UCB for Top-k-regret admits the bound R_T^k \le (2[\frac{2\alpha n^2}{(2\alpha-1)\delta}]^{\frac{1}{2\alpha-1}} + 2\bar D^{(k)}\ln(2\bar D^{(k)}))\Delta'_{\max} + \frac{4\alpha\ln T}{k}(\sum_{b=k+1}^n\frac{(\theta_k-\theta_b)}{\hat D^2})

results.notes: hat D depends on b though written without index.

bound.expression_latex: \bigg( 2\Big[ \frac{2\alpha n^2}{(2\alpha-1)} \Big]^{\frac{1}{2\alpha-1}}\frac{2\alpha-1}{\alpha-1} + 2\bar D^{(k)}\ln \big( 2\bar D^{(k)} \big) \bigg) \Delta'_{\max} + \frac{4\alpha\ln T}{k}\bigg(\sum_{b = k+1}^{n}\frac{(\theta_k-\theta_b)}{{\hat D}^2} \bigg)

source.label: thm:exp_reg_kmm
source.quote: The expected regret incurred by MaxMin-UCB for Top-k-regret is: E[R_T^1] \le ( 2[\frac{2\alpha n^2}{(2\alpha-1)}]^{\frac{1}{2\alpha-1}}\frac{2\alpha-1}{\alpha-1} + 2\bar D^{(k)}\ln(2\bar D^{(k)}))\Delta'_{\max} + \frac{4\alpha\ln T}{k}(\sum_{b=k+1}^n\frac{(\theta_k-\theta_b)}{\hat D^2}).

results.notes: Statement says MaxMin-UCB and R_T^1 — evidently typos for Rec-MaxMin-UCB and R_T^k.
